abstract: Pick, install, configure, and verify Capacitor plugins. Covers official @capacitor/* packages for Capacitor 8.5 (and 9 alpha on next), including the 8.1+ Camera API and new Calendar, Contacts, Health Fitness, and Local LLM plugins, plus a generated index of 145 @capgo/* packages with install steps, platforms, API methods, and docs links. Includes native permission setup, npx cap sync / cap ls verification, and fixes for 'plugin is not implemented', UNIMPLEMENTED, and OS-PLUG-* errors.
